signals.name: runtime_alive
signals.alert: unreachable; production probing cadence to be verified

signals.name: oneshot_active_or_ambiguous
signals.alert: CLAIMED beyond lease or AMBIGUOUS; no automatic retry

signals.name: continuous_claims_and_queue
signals.alert: expired claim, REVIEW_REQUIRED, backlog, expiry; inspect bounded resources

signals.name: provider_outstanding_liability
signals.alert: reserved, dispatching or unknown; unknown cost remains unresolved

signals.name: provider_attempts_and_cost
signals.source: genesis_provider_attempts and immutable genesis_provider_receipts through trusted private inspection
signals.alert: budget ceiling or usage unknown; no body export

signals.name: cycle_commit_failure
signals.alert: committed count disagreement or failed/ambiguous transition

signals.name: worker_stopped_idle
signals.source: consumer process exit and continuous journal/resources
signals.alert: unexpected running process without reviewed session or missed supervised stop

signals.name: schema_mismatch
signals.alert: block public projection and consumers; no boot repair

limitations: Health does not prove DB readiness
Managed host alert delivery and retention require infrastructure verification
Operator inspection results can contain private state and are not public metrics
